notes.title: Free Game Update: City Update Now Live
notes.notes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30559558/6f039c4105a5469d3bac92883b1972fd1db01ae2.jpg[/img]

[b]New[/b]
- City and map update
- Day/Night cycle
- Functional night lights in city and around the map
- Updated city police and fire station interiors
- New access road connecting Cod Town department area with outside street
- New road connecting harbour area with city North bridge
- Missions updated for the new city and added new spawn locations 
- Parked cars updated in the city and around the map
- Added fire hydrants at harbour
- Added sort numbers in mission editor's locations list

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Suspects put in swat van rear no longer become stretchy
- Map area loader could get stuck if player or camera reached near the map edges

- Removed navigation areas for AI inside buildings without interiors
- Night time adjusted to be a little darker
- Night and traffic lights now turn on earlier in evening
- Mac white glow glitch fixed in City and Beach Town
- Various map, buildings and terrain fixes
- The confirm menu for changing screen resolution in graphics settings was broken

[i]Note: We previously announced plans to add street names to the minimap HUD, but this has now been moved back to the next planned update.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30559558/18962a51f9d18bd0ade5317da65eb4c38b9c0cdc.jpg[/img]

Capable of carrying a large quantity of water and all the equipment needed for emergency firefighting situations.

The Flashing Lights Team

We are also happy to announce the Emergency Response Lightbar Collection is out now.
This comes with 10 new highly requested lightbars. Each can be used with all departments and most vehicles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649420/

[h2]Full Patch Notes - 29/10/2024 Unstable Build[/h2]

[b]AI Backup (Singleplayer Only)[/b]
- Use radio to call for backup (Default key "Tab" where you choose to control partners or call for backup)
- Texture mods for backup vehicles and characters (Using Slot 1 in Assign Menu for each model)
- Command backup AI characters while they are out of car
- Police backup (Police Car, Sheriff SUV, Swat Van)
- Firefighters backup (Engine Truck, Fire SUV)
- EMS Backup (Ambulance, First Responder SUV)

[b]New[/b]
- Light patterns on Mod.io (Add prefix Lights_ to exported file, example: Lights_My Mod Name.txt and upload as .zip (no folders))
- Dispatch now give calls around players (1300m radius), the range limit is ignored when using next mission command [/nm_]
- Sheriff partner character
- More props for pedestrian crossings in City East, Cod Town, Beach Town and City Marina
- Partners and backup units now show on minimap and full map UI

[b]Traffic Spawner Improvements[/b]
- New waypoint finder around player (might improve multiplayer lag with 6+ players)
- Using optimized waypoint finder the spawner will try to use free spots to spawn more traffic
- Distanced traffic optimization (based on distance it will turn off AI driver character or wheel animations)
- Pedestrian waypoints added in City East, Port and Beach Town Pier

[b]Pedestrian and Traffic Fixes[/b]
- NPC loading improved to fix loading hickups at game start and when loading missions (The NPC pool now has 60 pedestrians which should be enough for default pedestrian count and missions, if for custom missions need more, it may load more pedestrians but could cause some hickups)

- NPC in missions now despawn when player cancel the mission and leave area
- NPC pedestrians no longer stop spawning after a while
- When loading a game, now only the host creates NPC pedestrians and traffic, solving an issue with clients loading duplicate NPCs and traffic unnecessarily, causing lag for all players and memory increase 
- Sorting and fixes for multiplayer entity ID mismatch causing random sync issues and lag while Photon tried to fix it with destroying NPC clones and creating new instances
- Pedestrians no longer spawn partially in the ground while loading before they start walking
- Pedestrians no longer walk around with a gun floating in front of their head
- Function for missing traffic lights in City East and Beach Town

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Multiplayer car seat rotation sync fix for players
- In multiplayer sometimes pedestrians stopped walking
- Toggle auto-off sirens setting now saves when you get out of your vehicle
- On each game load and each vehicle menu launch, customized siren slots previously got messed up
- Beach Town pier poles rendering fix
- Hovering parked cars aligned with ground in Beach Town and Cod Town
- Parked cars are now using optimized traffic car models
- Changed default setting for parked cars from Low to Medium when creating a game
- Changed default vehicles for new players (SUV for police and Engine for firefighters)
- Map buildings and roads were previously loaded duplicate on CPU
- NPC vehicles have correct lights when at night
- Fixed an issue that caused the UI to freeze if double clicking on done in character menu
- Minimap water texture fixed

Thanks,
The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: AI Update Part 1: AI Partners - OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We're excited to announce that AI Update Part 1: AI Partners is OUT NOW on the default branch, meaning it's available for everyone! A huge thanks to all of you who helped test this update when it was on the unstable branch <3

Get out there and save the city - now with AI partners! At the police station, fire station or hospital, select your AI partner by interacting with the relevant marker and head out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30559558/a671d87fe4905373255ed3445f3476b07c91652c.jpg[/img]

[h1]AI Update Part 1 - AI Partners[/h1]

[b]Police Partners[/b]

The police partners will be able to frisk and arrest suspects, shoot back if being shot at, and chase down suspects. They can also ride in your vehicles and be told to wait at locations or in a vehicle.

[b]Firefighter Partners[/b]

These partners can help put out fires using extinguishers, use hydraulic spreaders to rescue persons trapped in vehicles. They can also ride in your vehicles and be told to wait at locations or in a vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30559558/723ce44678b54979e7b96f9686d40ab00097e207.jpg[/img]

[b]EMS Partners[/b]

EMS partners can prepare patients for transport for you by working through the treatment checklist, before you either transport the patient yourself or call for AI transport. You can also set your EMS partners to wait for your command before running to a patient, meaning you can command them to attend one patient while you take care of another.

Nils is now working on AI Update Part 2 - AI Backup! This update will allow you to call for backup when out on callouts, arriving and then leaving the scene when the situation is dealt with.

Watch out for news!

Thanks,
The Flashing Lights Team

- Locate Partners icon in departments (limited AI character to choose from for now)
- Press TAB to toggle mouse cursor to select AI's commands in upper right corner

Jump into the new Mission Editor, which allows you to customise your experience by using game tools to create your own callouts! Select NPC types, vehicle props, environment props, fire and more. The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: NEW UPDATE NOW LIVE - New Player Character Options, Further Police Callout Variety, Tons of Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/72d7ca8fb43b0d90be8525c89505eff89aab8fc4.gif[/img]

Hello everyone,

As we revealed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/605740/announcements/detail/2698103696740559891]last week[/url], today's update focuses on new character and player models in game. 

Flashing Lights now features six playable characters for each department, with an equal number of male and female options. There are also six new NPC models, we've introduced changes to a police mission, and added a player list available to view during online games. On top of that, there are tons of important bug fixes, so make sure to read the full patch notes towards the end of this announcement. Read on for all of the details!

[h1]New Player Character Options[/h1]

We've replaced all departments' characters with new models and textures using Adobe Fuse - a lovely character creator tool which allows us to quickly introduce new characters into the game. There are now six player character options per department.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/cfbbdedfe65e0380ead7e17fea76060509d770fb.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/3dbee7da4c2e8473a7850fce28f17d58830a595e.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/885236329f1361743aee1c4413951d79149d87a5.gif[/img]

The software also comes with a selection of new animations... one of which was given to a player model accidentally but did make him much more fabulous!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/4a10d4d6fcf8e1ab0f5e9bb7b06df6a61c40c827.gif[/img]

This was a random idle pose that we had imported into the game. It doesn't really reflect the rest of the presentation, so we have not included it in this build. The pose made holding fire extinguishers while idle look incredibly odd.

[h1]New NPC Models[/h1]
Since launch, players have arrested and rescued thousands of bald men in white vests. Our first wave of diverse NPCs are now live, meaning that the days of bald, white vest guy-only are over.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/e759dde281c63fb8236bb3528a641c48885fa847.png[/img]

We have had to disable the hats and glasses temporarily, but be assure that they will return alongside more customisation options.

[h1]Changes to Police Missions[/h1]
Additionally, we have made some changes to the police callouts. The 'Officer Needs Assistance' callout can now take place in one of over 10,000 locations on the map. Once we iron out many of the issues with this system, we do plan to introduce this to other callouts, increasing gameplay variety.

We will definitely need help from the community to spot any issues where the callout spawns in an odd place! Make sure to let us know if the callout spawns underground or such by posting on the forums.

[h1]Player List for Online Multiplayer[/h1]
We've added a new player list for those of you playing online. Simply hold the Tab key during an online game and a list of all the players currently in the server will appear, alongside information on further details at the very top of the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/28aa85c209f0a6078975564f23f3af8092305a7d.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we have added a few text commands allowing the host of the server to control who they want in their games. The following commands can be used while in the chat box to kick (remove a player from the current lobby) or ban (disable a player's ability to rejoin the current session) a player.

/kick_PlayerID
/ban_PlayerID

The text 'PlayerID' simply needs to be replaced by the player's ID - the four number code listed by the player's name in the player list. For example, the player IDs of the players in the screenshot above are '1006', '2001' and '3001'.

That's it for this week's update! We are still hard at work on addressing bugs and adding more content to the game. Thank you to everyone who has supported us over the last five weeks and a big welcome to those of you who are joining us now.

As a reminder, the Flashing Lights Discord community is still growing, with tons of community discussion and input from ourselves. Make sure to join in for access to new update testing opportunities.

discord.gg/flashinglights

The full change log can be found below:

[h1]Build 170718-1[/h1]

[h1]New[/h1]

- 18 new player character models (hats and glasses temporary disabled) replace the existing ones. various female player characters now available across all departments.
- 6 NPC civilian models introduced.
- Player list added to multiplayer. Mapped by default to the Tab key. You need to hold Tab to access the player list.
- Multiplayer host can now kick and ban players, using the chat commands /kick_PlayerID and /ban_PlayerID
- Audio settings added
- Police mission “Officer needs assistance” now appears in random locations on the map. Previous manually set locations removed.
- Ability to centre the camera while in first person driving mode introduced. Mapped by default to the R key.

[h1]Fixes and Adjustments[/h1]

- Multiplayer suspects no longer disappear.
- The player character can no longer fall through the ground when spawning.
- Player characters no longer de-sync when a client joins. Previously there was a chance that player characters would sit in the wrong vehicle seat when this happened.
- Suspect can no longer be stopped while in an on-foot chase by the player clicking to talk to them. Suspects now only stop when tasered.
- Speed gun MPH bug fixed. Previously the speed displayed in km/h.
- Player characters' feet no longer stick out of vehicles or morph through seats.
- Character tool/weapon IK adjustments. This should improve the stance of the characters hands when holding a weapon.
- Vehicle seat position adjustments implemented.
- vehicle sound is no longer affected by movement of the mouse.
- Alcohol test max value adjusted to 0.3.
- Fixed an issue where after using the Jaws of Life to open the door, you would need to use it again before you could interact with the patient with the med bag
- Only vehicles can now displace road signs, not characters.
- Fixed an issue where the player character would jitter when sat in another player's vehicle.
- Player minimap tag now appears on spawn, rather than shown when loading into the game.
- If all involved players in a call change role or leave the session, the mission will now cancel.
- Drunk drivers now swerve left/right.
- Interaction menus and trunk - left click now acts as accept, right click as back.
- The player now receives negative reputation points when arresting an innocent NPC.
- Taking out a suspect from another player’s vehicle now works as intended.
- Hitting signs will no longer stop the vehicle completely.
- Drunk driver callout description text altered.

Thanks,
The Flashing Lights Team

notes.title: Update Now Live - 11 New Police Callouts, 10 Player Online Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We have just launched another content update! This week, we've focused on new police callouts (11 of them!), and also increased the number of players that can play on one server from six to ten.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/2cd3152f0e88d405b24df43e1d1bbbe054182703.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]

[list]

[*]Ten player multiplayer introduced. The maximum amount of players on a single server has been increased from six to ten.

[*]Six police suspicious activity callouts [Call ID 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006] These involve searching around the area for suspicious activity and making arrests if necessary.

[*]Four police officer needs assistance callouts [Call ID 1007, 1008, 1009, 1010] These involve assisting fellow police officers who are not quite in control of the situation - and you are needed to chase after a fleeing suspect on-foot.

[list]

[*]Callouts now continue to appear in multiplayer after the host leaves the game

[*]Your character no longer constantly moves once any control inputs have been remapped

[*]Fixed an issue where your vehicle would not appear after you lost connection to a server and joined another

[*]Updated translations for Japanese, Simplified Chinese, German, Russian and Spanish

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/a90e5b1b81189f098402138a4af34ea63f3821f4.png[/img]

notes.title: Traffic Lights, Parking Tickets, Quick Update On Art
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We hope that everyone has had an excellent start to 2018. We've come back from the holidays fully charged and eager to hop on to develop the game. Over the past few weeks we've been working on the AI traffic and the parking ticket system.

[h1] Traffic AI[/h1]
AI drivers were previously a menace to society, ignoring any designated rules of the road and causing a selection of disastrous vehicular collisions which not only caused some vehicles to probably be classified as write offs, but would also cause a pile up of stationary vehicles blocking traffic. 

Some work has however been done to improve the AI and they now stop and yield to incoming traffic at intersections. While this should of course be expected, we're still pleased with how the system is working right now.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/8e44e5faa9e10ca5a3d2ac6f85f5cb6492f361d5.gif[/img]

Additionally, we've also worked on Traffic light systems and have synchronized the lights so that they work with online multiplayer. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/b136dbbb44b867c94f36bf27635727137eb91e8f.gif[/img]

[h1]Parking[/h1]
When loading the game, each session will see cars placed in various parking spots. This kind of adds to the world as there is always a row of cars on the road. But there will be times when a busy road may have fewer cars parked in that particular area and other times when a quiet cul de sac will see an increase in parked cars. Of course, this leads to the environment changing slightly and may even play a factor in accessibility to certain areas.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/533fbbdb486ceb19a177100188df04cf62602b4c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Parking Tickets[/h1]
The bane of the average driver, parking tickets. As an on the beat police officer you will be able to issue parking tickets to various vehicles based on whether they were in a no parking zone, parked in a handicapped area without displaying a proper disabled badge. You as the player will need to decide what reason you are issuing a parking ticket and then fill out the form

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/b94fc2d0b33edac3fbd9bd6518d5c704d716bb03.gif[/img]

Any tickets that you create will then be placed on the actual vehicle and can be seen and read by other players online.

[h1]Online Multiplayer Testing With PC and MAC[/h1]
Flashing Lights Early Access release will see both PC and MAC support. We've been doing some testing with both platforms communicating with each other online. Everything seems to be working pretty much right away! So regardless of your friends platform of choice, you'll be able to play with them. Below are just a few images of a Mac and PC player playing online together

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/12376153f77053e43224eb23de80fcc54fbd6bfa.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/d68601103f7b4ed52ca9f11291a1a7f56ad0644d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30559558/69aa423f5d341b3f693dd939c78b794f905a1fe8.jpg[/img]

Note: We do not condone any fire department to blast a police officer in the face with a water directly from a fire hose, there's a high probability that they won't take too kindly to that...

[h1]Short Graphics And Art Update[/h1]
In other news we are at the stages of working with an art audio who will be creating 3D models for Flashing Lights. We are anticipating that we will also be working with other individual artists for game objects too. Nothing is quite yet set in stone, but we hope that working with these artists will definitely allow us to bring Flashing Lights up to scratch on a visual level

So there we have it! this week has been working on parts of the AI and elements of the police role. Next month we will be looking at introducing a few game mechanics to both the Fire and EMS so stay tuned for some more info on those services in due course!

Thanks to everyone who has shown support in Flashing Lights, we've seen a massive spike in the forums and even on the figures for the wishlist numbers on Steam. If you have come across the game and want to be kept up to date with news, do add the game to your wishlist. More news will be incoming soon!
